name: Cafe with terrace (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: One-storey cafe, 12 x 10 m: a rendered box with tall glazing, a glazed double door onto a timber-decked front terrace under a steel-framed canopy with a blank fascia sign, glass windbreak screens and planters. Inside: the cafe dining room with a fixed service counter (display case, coffee machine, pass hatch), a small kitchen with a fixed cooking line and hood, a store and a toilet.
